text:
Bloke in Kingsley has paid for a gym membership since 2011. Went twice. (Still not fit.)

Google rankings work like that gym. Being open since 2011 won't hold your spot on the map.

The new business that adds photos to its Google profile and asks every customer for a review climbs past you.

Keep your ad simple.

One photo. One offer. One line that says who it's for.

"Gutter cleaning in Rockingham. Free quote this week."

Every extra word in an ad is one more reason for someone to keep scrolling.

Google's core update started 10 November. It takes up to two weeks.

Search your service and suburb today. "Physio Midland." Write down where you show up.

Check again once the update finishes. Compare the two spots.
